decisions.reason: As a brand-consistent candle arch variant within the firm's traditional handcrafted Christmas décor, it is still more likely to stay than to be cut despite reduced later visibility.
This one-tier Christmas pyramid is very close to the firm's core assortment and the kind of timeless seasonal item such workshops typically retain for years.
Because it is an accessory for the electronic music-box concept that was already withdrawn, it has little strategic fit left and is the clearest candidate to be rationalized out.
